sloka: अथाब्रवीदृशग्रीवं नारदो भगवानृषिः ।क्व खल्विदानीं मार्गेण त्वया ह्यन्येन गम्यते ।। ७.२०.२० ॥
transliteration: athābravīdṛśagrīvaṁ nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ ।kva khalvidānīṁ mārgeṇa tvayā hyanyena gamyate ।। 7.20.20 ॥

translations.english: Ravana further states that after conquering the three worlds and subjugating the Nagas and gods, he will churn the ocean for nectar.
